name: Shadow Walker's Ring
lore: A matte-black ring that seems to absorb light from its surroundings, worn by the leader of an ancient thieves' guild who specialized in assassinations too dangerous for ordinary operatives. As one of the three pieces of the Shadow Walker's Set, wearing it alongside the Adamantine Dagger and the Dragonscale Cloak grants a poison strike on all attacks and the ability to move silently regardless of armor worn.
